A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BARNN research. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D are readable and support reliable comparison despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and Appendices B–C report original PDE-solving and molecular-generation experiments, including quantitative comparisons, sensitivity studies, and error analyses.

after.justification: The original PDE and molecular-generation results are retained, and Section 4.1 adds original synthetic time-series forecasting results.

M1.justification: The state-weight model, temporal ELBO, variational dropout, tVAMP construction, and Algorithms 1–3 are retained. The layer-weight correction in Equation 9 aligns the main text with the existing Appendix A.3 derivation; it does not establish a changed training or inference procedure.

E1.justification: Section 4.1 adds a controlled forecasting task using synthetic sinusoidal sequences with varying frequencies and phases. This provides a limited extension beyond the retained Burgers, KS, KdV, and ChEMBL evaluations.

E2.justification: New Table 1 includes static initial-state and deterministic MLP references, alongside a log-uniform-prior BARNN variant and Monte Carlo Dropout. The comparator sets in the existing PDE and molecular-generation experiments remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The new forecasting protocol uses 1,024 training and 100 test trajectories, 100 time steps, a two-layer 64-unit ReLU network, and 1,500 Adam epochs. Existing experimental settings are retained. The new table inconsistently calls its error metric MSE in the header and RMSE in the caption.

E4.justification: Section 4.1 and Table 1 add a targeted prior-choice ablation comparing tVAMP with a log-uniform prior under a shared architecture. Existing ensemble-size studies, baseline hyperparameter sweeps, molecular error analyses, and temperature-sensitivity results are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions retain four-initialization mean/std reporting for the principal PDE and molecular results and single-seed PDE tuning studies. New Table 1 adds plus/minus entries without specifying a run count or introducing a different uncertainty-estimation or significance-testing procedure.

E6.justification: New Table 1 reports synthetic forecasting results, including NLL of -0.166 ± 0.019 for tVAMP versus -0.092 ± 0.064 for the log-uniform variant. These are newly reported comparisons, not improvements over v1 under an existing setting. Matched PDE and molecular results, including appendix plots and tables, are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation 9 replaces the common weight-count factor outside the layer sum with each layer's parameter count inside its term. This corrects the compact KL expression to agree with the retained Appendix A.3 derivation. The remaining formal assumptions and proofs are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions: Bayesian conversion of autoregressive/recurrent models, the temporal variational objective, tVAMP, calibrated PDE uncertainty, and improved molecular generation. The added forecasting experiment supports these retained claims.

C2.justification: Section 4.1 newly interprets the forecasting comparison as evidence that tVAMP improves predictive uncertainty and accuracy relative to a log-uniform prior. Existing interpretations of PDE calibration, molecular dependencies, applicability, and future research remain unchanged.

D1.justification: V2 adds a public-code URL in Section 4 and specifies the synthetic data generator, architecture, optimizer, and training hyperparameters. Existing PDE and molecular implementation details, hardware descriptions, and software information are retained; the repository's availability was not externally checked.

R1.justification: V2 adds the Kingma and Ba Adam reference for the new forecasting experiment. The existing related-work coverage and positioning of BARNN relative to variational dropout, VAMP, neural PDE solvers, and molecular language models remain unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 inserts the Time Series subsection, reverses the software and pseudocode subsections in Appendix D, and makes limited wording, affiliation, and acknowledgment edits. Most existing explanatory prose and the overall narrative organization are retained.

P2.justification: The main text and references change from a single-column layout to an ICML two-column format. Figures and tables are redistributed, the PDE NLL/ECE table becomes stacked panels, and the forecasting table is added. Existing figure content is retained rather than replaced.

improvement.justification: V2 adds a direct test of tVAMP against a log-uniform prior, supplies code-access information, and corrects the main-text KL layer weighting. These modestly strengthen empirical support, reproducibility information, and mathematical clarity. The original application results remain unchanged, while the new table's MSE/RMSE inconsistency and unspecified run count limit the clarity of the added evidence.
